title: Persist a local reading recommendation and enforce librarian actions
outcome: Reader recommendations persist; only librarian identity can mark read; browser reflects the result
scope: Synthetic loopback browser, HTTP API and temporary file store
nonGoals: Production identity, external services, deployment, account administration
invariants: Failed writes never report saved success
Saved state survives ordinary process restart
authority: Run this synthetic example and its tests with isolated temporary data

obligations.description: Exercise role enforcement, data validation, storage failure and restart over real HTTP
Operate the real browser through the required user journey
obligations.external: Use a browser against the current build to verify both roles, submission, refresh, read action, validation and offline feedback. HTTP tests do not establish these interactions; observation attachments do not automatically satisfy this obligation.
